extDescription.message: Wrap a word in <tags></tags> with one key and auto-close tags. Handy for structuring prompts for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI.

popupUnavailable.message: Extensions can't run on this page

optSubtitle.message: Wrap words in tags with one key — for clean, structured AI prompts.

optEnabledHint.message: Turn off to pause AutoTagMate on all sites.

optKeyHint.message: Click the field and press a combination, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+K. If there is nothing to wrap, the key works as usual.

optKeyForbidden.message: This key is needed for typing. Pick another one or add Ctrl / Alt.

optAutoCloseHint.message: Typing <tag> inserts </tag> right after the cursor.

optExcludedHint.message: One site per line. Subdomains are excluded too.

optHow1.message: No selection: the word before the cursor becomes <word></word>, the cursor goes between the tags.

optHow2.message: With a selection: the selected text becomes the tag name.

optHow3.message: Works in text fields and rich editors — ChatGPT, Claude, Gmail. Ctrl+Z undoes the change.
